clips.title: The story
paras: Billy Maclure is a mischievous young human boy living at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Caught in the midst of a bitter feud between his family and the neighboring Stonefields, Billy's petty antics often cause trouble for both farms. His weakness for fresh pastries makes him easy to bribe when his shenanigans get out of hand.

Billy Maclure can usually be found loitering outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, not far from the farmer Gerard Tiller. Growing up amidst the endless rows of grapevines, Billy spends much of his time dodging chores and running wild across the rural meadows of central Elwynn Forest. Like the rest of his kin, he is keenly aware of the long-standing hostility between the Maclures and the Stonefields, though Billy treats the feud more like a game of pranks and petty theft than a serious conflict.
